s: pervy, kinky, sexually perverted or deviant
pervers.et: 16th century, from Latin perversus, in part through Middle French pervers.

s: A former trade name for methamphetamine, known for its use by the Wehrmacht in World War II.
Pervitin.et: Marketing coinage, introduced 1938 by Temmler Werke (discontinued 1988).

Perversion.et: Learned borrowing from Latin perversiōnis. By surface analysis, pervers + -ion.
